sentences: Black leather-look crossbody baguette bag with an embossed “TREND. UNIFIED COLORS” text pattern. The compact curved rectangular shape features a long black shoulder strap, gold-tone zipper pulls, and a small gold-tone logo plaque on the front. Finished with tonal stitching and a structured soft-look body.

Multicolor tropical leaf print cropped blouse with an off-shoulder elastic neckline and long sleeves. The top features a black base with yellow, red, teal, white, and beige foliage pattern, a fitted cropped silhouette, and a lightweight woven fabric appearance. No visible brand, logo, or closure.

Dusty pink crossbody bag with a rectangular soft-sided shape and tonal embossed text reading “UNIFIED COLORS OF TREND.” The front features a gold-tone interlocking logo charm, black zipper closure, and matching pink shoulder strap with metal hardware. Compact pouch-style design with a smooth fabric-like exterior and rounded corners.

Off-white long-sleeve top with a draped cowl neckline and gathered shoulder detailing. The solid-color design has a soft jersey-knit appearance, slim sleeves, and a straight hem. The front features layered ruched folds across the neckline and shoulders, creating a relaxed, fitted silhouette.

Gold-tone statement ring with an oval tortoiseshell-look center stone in amber, brown, and black. The polished oval cabochon is framed by a halo of small clear stones, set on a slim metal band. A bold cocktail ring design with a glossy resin-like appearance and decorative stone border.

Gold-tone statement ring featuring a large round turquoise-blue cabochon stone in a raised prong setting. The ornate metal band has textured detailing, raised bead accents, and small clear stone-like embellishments around the base. A bold cocktail ring design with a domed center stone and decorative side detailing.

Glossy ceramic elephant figurine in bright yellow-orange with multicolor polka dots in blue, red, green, and pink. The small animal figure has oversized rounded ears, a raised trunk, cartoon eyes, a smiling mouth, and a small orange tuft on top. Compact decorative animal statue with a smooth glazed finish.

Puma Galatasaray football jersey and shorts set in red and orange color-block design. The short-sleeve jersey has a black V-neck trim, vertical black center stripe, Puma logo, Galatasaray crest with “1905” and four stars, and large white “SIXT” sponsor text. Paired with plain black shorts with an elastic waistband.

Pair of glossy ceramic cow figurines with a cream base and black spotted pattern. Each cow has a rounded seated shape, raised ears, small horns, painted facial details, and a pink polka-dot bow on the chest. The set has a decorative kitchen or shelf decor style with a smooth glazed finish.

Black and white gingham check mini dress with a loose fit and long sleeves. Features a V-neckline with a white drawstring and tassel ties, gathered waist seam, and tiered ruffle hem. The lightweight woven fabric has a small check pattern throughout, with a relaxed boho-style silhouette.

White cropped blouse with a blue floral and black polka dot print. Features a sweetheart neckline, fitted ruched bodice, and a gathered center front detail. The top has wide shoulder straps and sheer long puff sleeves with a lightweight, semi-transparent fabric appearance.

Black cropped blouse with an allover white floral print. Features a square neckline with a sweetheart-style front dip, fitted cropped bodice, and short puff sleeves with gathered cuffs. The lightweight woven fabric has a soft drape, creating a structured yet relaxed silhouette.

ANYLADY eyeshadow palette in a pink square compact with a clear lid printed with cherry blossom graphics and the ANYLADY logo. The palette contains nine warm-toned shades in coral, terracotta, rose, bronze, and champagne, with a mix of matte, shimmer, and chunky glitter finishes. Includes round and flower-shaped pans in a cream tray.

Decorative hanging ornament with a gold twisted cord and multiple small clear plastic tube charms. Each tube is filled with round beads or pebble-like pieces in red, beige, and brown tones, topped with green-and-white check fabric covers and tied with gold cord. Includes small blue and purple bead accents for a handmade craft-style look.

NYX Professional Makeup Eyeshadow Palette in a clear rectangular plastic compact with a hinged lid. The palette features nine square pans of warm neutral eyeshadows in bronze, copper, peach, tan, and brown tones, with a mix of matte and shimmer finishes. Visible text includes “NYX,” “EYESHADOW PALETTE,” and “PROFESSIONAL MAKEUP.”
